name: planningpoker
originalPrompt:
Create a premium technology conference website for TECHNOVATE 2027.

Design a futuristic, professional landing page with a dark navy background, purple and electric blue gradients.

Include:
- Hero section with large conference title
- Date, venue and countdown
- Register Now button
- Featured keynote speakers with profile images
- Conference agenda and session schedule
- Event highlights
- Sponsors section
- Ticket pricing cards
- Contact and footer

Use modern typography, glassmorphism cards,
smooth animations and responsive layouts.
Make it look like a premium international tech summit.
